import math
R=60
r=20
L=100
H=90
D=40
z0=30
outer=(cq.Workplane('XZ').moveTo(0,0).lineTo(0,z0).threePointArc((R-R/math.sqrt(2),z0+R/math.sqrt(2)),(R,H)).lineTo(L,H).lineTo(L,z0+r).lineTo(R,z0+r).threePointArc((R-r/math.sqrt(2),z0+r/math.sqrt(2)),(R-r,z0)).lineTo(R-r,0).close().extrude(D))
t=1.5
inner=(cq.Workplane('XZ',origin=(0,-t,0)).moveTo(t,-1).lineTo(t,z0).threePointArc((R-(R-t)/math.sqrt(2),z0+(R-t)/math.sqrt(2)),(R,H-t)).lineTo(L+1,H-t).lineTo(L+1,z0+r+t).lineTo(R,z0+r+t).threePointArc((R-(r+t)/math.sqrt(2),z0+(r+t)/math.sqrt(2)),(R-r-t,z0)).lineTo(R-r-t,-1).close().extrude(D-2*t))
result=outer.cut(inner)
